**[[Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes (2024–present)|Afghanistan–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
***Nineteen [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] and 45 [[Pakistani Taliban]] militants are killed at two hideouts near the [[Durand Line]] in [[Bajaur District]] and [[South Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], during clashes in the past two days. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 61 people, mostly [[Sudanese refugees]], are missing after a boat carrying 74 passengers capsized off [[Tobruk]], [[Cyrenaica]], [[Libya]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/61-people-missing-in-another-boat-wreck-off-libya-unhcr-adfc4a5f (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*At least 19 people are killed after a bus carrying wedding guests plunged into a river in [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-xl/africa/kenya/nigeria-19-women-children-killed-after-bus-carrying-wedding-guests-crashes/ar-AA1Myn5E?ocid=BingNewsSerp (MSN)]
*At least 15 people are killed in a [[multi-vehicle collision]] along [[Mexican Federal Highway 180|Federal Highway 180]] between [[Campeche (city)|Campeche]] and [[Mérida, Yucatán|Mérida]] in southeast [[Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/fiery-accident-leaves-15-dead-mexicos-yucatan-peninsula-2025-09-14/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are killed and one is injured after a passenger [[de Havilland Canada DHC-2 Beaver]] crashes near Makepeace Lake in [[Manitoba]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/manitoba/island-lake-float-plane-crash-1.7633673 (CBC)]
*One person is killed and 25 others are injured, including three critically, in an explosion due to a [[gas leak]] at a bar in [[Madrid]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/spain-one-killed-dozens-injured-in-madrid-bar-explosion/a-73986273 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests]]
**The government of [[Nepal]] lifts the [[curfew]] in [[Bhaktapur]], [[Kathmandu]], and [[Lalitpur, Nepal|Lalitpur]], imposed on September 9, citing restored calm after [[Sushila Karki]]'s appointment as [[Interim government of Sushila Karki|interim]] [[Prime Minister of Nepal|prime minister]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-protests-curfew-sushila-karki-9b315d03aa5adb18cba1f28b11da4dc5 (AP)]
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**Seven people are killed in a shooting by criminal gangs at a [[pool hall]] in [[Santo Domingo, Ecuador|Santo Domingo]], [[Ecuador]], less than a month after a similar attack at a different pool hall in the city which also killed seven people. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pool-hall-mass-shooting-ecuador-deaths-latest-massacre/ (CBS News)] [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-violence-gangs-shooting-pool-hall-d5aeb150ee5471368085d5d3b701ae0e (AP)]
*The [[Germany|German]] [[Customs Investigation Bureau (Germany)|customs bureau]] arrests two men and seizes over {{cvt|400|kg|lbs|abbr=on}} of [[cocaine]] at the [[Port of Hamburg|port]] in [[Hamburg]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-police-seize-400-kilograms-of-cocaine-at-hamburg-port/a-73986691 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 British anti-immigration protests]]
**More than 100,000 people protest against [[illegal immigration]] in [[central London]], [[England]], in a rally led by [[Right-wing politics|right-wing]] activist [[Tommy Robinson]]. Thousands of [[anti-racism]] protesters and [[Left-wing politics|left-wing groups]] also hold [[counter-protest]]s. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwydezxl0xlo (BBC News)]
*[[2025 Tanzanian general election]]
**[[Tanzania]]'s [[National Electoral Commission (Tanzania)|electoral commission]] accepts the nomination of [[ACT-Wazalendo]] candidate [[Luhaga Mpina]] for the upcoming presidential election after the [[High Court of Tanzania|High Court]] overturned Mpina's earlier disqualification. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/opposition-candidate-mpina-cleared-contest-tanzania-presidential-election-2025-09-13/ (Reuters)]
